description_en: Verifies the ownership of a domain name
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi verify-domain-owner --instance-id 'waf_v2_public_cn-*****' --domain-name example.com --verify-type dnsCheck --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: VerifyDomainOwner

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name to query.

You can set this parameter to perform a fuzzy match to check whether a domain name is added to WAF
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的域名名称。

您可以设置该参数，模糊查询某个域名是否已接入WAF防护
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The verification method. Valid values:

dnsCheck: DNS verification.
fileCheck: File verification
parameters.help_zh:
校验方式，取值：

dnsCheck：DNS验证。
fileCheck：文件验证
parameters.name: verify_type

parameters.help_en:
The protocol type used for file verification. This parameter is required only when VerifyType is set to fileCheck. Valid values:
HTTP: HTTP.
HTTPS: HTTPS
parameters.help_zh:
文件验证时，使用的协议类型，近在VerifyType选择fileCheck时输入。取值：
HTTP：表示HTTP协议。
HTTPS：表示HTTPS协议
parameters.name: protocol

FailCode.description_en:
The reason for verification failure.
DnsTxtVerifyFailed: The DNS TXT record does not match.
DnsServerError: A DNS server error occurred.
VerifyFileNotExist: The verification file does not exist.
VerifyDomainNotAccess: Access to the domain name failed.
FileContentVerifyFailed: The file content does not match
FailCode.description_zh:
校验不通过原因
DnsTxtVerifyFailed: DNS的TXT记录不匹配
DnsServerError: DNS服务器异常
VerifyFileNotExist：校验的文件不存在
VerifyDomainNotAccess：访问域名失败
FileContentVerifyFailed：文件内容不匹配

Result.description_en:
The verification result. Valid values:
true: The verification passed.
false: The verification failed
Result.description_zh:
校验结果。取值：
true：表示校验通过。
false：表示校验不通过
